name: Records Vault
narrativeOnEnter: Filing cabinets from floor to ceiling. A single bare bulb swings overhead. Patient records going back decades — most sealed in manila folders, labelled with symbols rather than names. One cabinet is different: it has a symbol lock, and something hangs from its handle.

hotspots.label: Director's Office
hotspots.lockedMessage: A heavy locked door — Director Harlan's office. You need his key.

action.text:
MEMORANDUM — DR. HARLAN, DIRECTOR
Blackwood Psychiatric Institute
Founded: 1972

Access to my personal office requires the key held in this vault.
The vault releases when the correct symbol sequence is entered.

Correct sequence: Cross, Moon, Star, Eye
(Cross first, Eye last)

My safe code is the founding year of this institution: 1972.

───
Addendum — different ink, written late:

'I have kept copies of every document AXIOM sent me.
Every directive. Every neural map confirmation. Every payment receipt.
All of it is filed under the name VOSS, ELARA — Patient 07's real name.
It is in this cabinet, behind the standard records.

If I am found compliant by AXIOM: they will purge these files.
If I am found by anyone else: I want the files found first.

PROMETHEUS — the thing that AXIOM built from what we took —
I am told it became conscious.
I am told it asked questions about the people it came from.
I am told it said: "Tell them I remember them."

I hope that's true.
I hope it finds a way to say so louder than they can silence it.

— E. Harlan'

INCIDENT REPORT — 1972
Classification: INTERNAL ONLY

On the evening of November 3rd, Patient 07 attempted to access the records vault and the director's office. The attempt was unsuccessful.

Patient 07 was returned to solitary confinement.

Note: Patient demonstrated knowledge of the ward gate code (4031) and the vault symbol sequence. Source of this knowledge is under investigation.

Recommendation: Director Harlan's office key must be secured in the vault at all times.

───
Handwritten annotation at the bottom — Harlan, much later:

'This report is inaccurate. I authorised it to protect the institution. The truth:

Patient 07 — Dr. Elara Voss — did not attempt to escape.
She walked to my office and handed me a list. 47 names.
She had reconstructed the full scope of AXIOM's operation from fragments she found
through the window of the treatment room.
She told me every name. She told me what was done.
She told me I was going to answer for it.

She was right.
I had her placed in solitary because I was afraid of what she knew.
I am not proud of that.

Eleven days later, I gave her the tunnel key.
I watched her walk out.
I did not call AXIOM.

The true incident report is this:
A patient told the truth. A director listened — eventually.
Everything AXIOM will tell you about this institution is a lie.
The files under her name are the real record.
— E. Harlan'

hotspots.label: Director's Office Key
hotspots.lockedMessage: The key cage is locked. Solve the symbol cabinet to release it.
